digest.component_or_area: llm/config.py module structure and size management
propositions: src/rebar/llm/config.py at 793 LOC is within 7 lines of an 800-line ceiling and has 93 modules depending on it, blocking new feature work like d23e's deprecation alias

The gate read-root/session domain (ContextVars and 11 functions spanning config.py:51-152 and :190-269) is inert cold mass unchanged since 2026-07-09 while all growth since then occurs in the knob region
Moving 219 lines of gate-context code to a new module creates ~160 lines of headroom in config.py and allows the seam test to tighten from <=800 to <700 LOC policy target
The relocation must preserve all re-exports from config.py so all 13 monkeypatch test targets continue to work without edits to any test file

The hardcoded logger identity 'rebar.llm.config' in assert_gated:230 must be repointed to the module that contains the code after the move to avoid sending log greps to the wrong file for an audited security warning
